name: observed_at
description: When the crawl observed the offer (UTC)

name: offer_id
description: The competitor's own ID for the offer

name: offer_name
description: The competitor's own name for the offer, not standardised

name: plan_tier
description: The competitor's own plan family or tier, e.g. Three Lite, EE TEEN, Vodafone BASICS_PLAN. Not comparable across competitors

name: data_allowance_gb
description: NULL when unlimited, or when the competitor gives no amount (e.g. EE's speed-capped Protected Plan)

name: monthly_price
description: GBP inc VAT paid per month at sign-up, after any automatic discount (not discount codes)

name: list_monthly_price
description: GBP inc VAT per month without the discount; equals monthly_price when there's no discount

name: discount_months
description: Months monthly_price lasts before reverting to list_monthly_price; the contract term for whole-contract discounts; NULL when there's no discount or its length is unknown

name: promotion_text
description: The competitor's promotion label as shown

name: promotion_code
description: Discount code mentioned in promotion_text, e.g. 2OFF

name: promotion_ends_on
description: End date mentioned in promotion_text, e.g. 'ends 5 November'

name: raw_text
description: Raw source record, e.g. the competitor's API JSON; crawler.reparse rebuilds rows from it
